'''Sense Current''' was a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] [[Fallanassi powers|power]]. The power allowed a Fallanassi to sense sentient beings by the ripples they make in the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]]. This power will detect the presence of sentient beings as well as their approximate numbers; at least to the limit of the Fallanassi's curent frame of reference.<ref name="J't'p'tan" />
